MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The reusable cable straps and surge protector fit my current desk organization work: I have recently added Ethernet connections and several accessories, so keeping their cables tidy and power connections consolidated feels useful.",
    "The cleaning cloth complements my recent electric duster purchase by helping me clean screens as well as the rest of my equipment. Backup power also interests me, although I would check my equipment's power needs first."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another HDMI cable and a similar 32GB microSD card repeat things I already have without giving me a clear reason to replace them or buy spares.",
    "A full-size SD card does not match my recent microSD needs, and an optical audio cable requires a connection need I have not shown. The external-drive case also assumes I have a drive to carry.",
    "The discontinued UPS is less appealing because I would investigate current options before committing to backup power."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Having bought cables and storage cards seems to have been treated as a reason to want more of them, even when my existing purchases may already meet those needs.",
    "General computer-accessory similarity seems to count too much when the actual connector, card format, or equipment I own determines whether something is useful."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My latest purchases point toward organizing, connecting, and maintaining my desk equipment, which makes complementary supplies more timely than replacements for older purchases.",
    "Compatibility and an unmet need matter: microSD is different from full-size SD, and a UPS requires checking my equipment's power requirements before I choose one.",
    "My Raspberry Pi purchases explain why another microSD card interests me, but owning a similar card means that interest does not imply I need one now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my computer setup interests, but only some distinguish useful next steps in organization and maintenance from accessories I already own or have no current need for."
}
